question.text: The number of digits in $20^{301}$ (given, $\log _{10} 2=0.3010$ is

solution.text:
Let $y=20^{301}$
Number of digits $=$ Integral part of
$\left(301 \log _{10} 20\right)+1$
Integral part of $\left.\left[301 \log _{10} 10+\log _{10} 2\right)\right]+1$
$=$ Integral part of $[301(1+0.3010)]+1$
$=$ Integral part of $[301 \times 1.3010]+1$
Integral part of $[391.601]+1$
$=391+1=392$
